static_traits.name: Lin Jing
static_traits.social_status: 有少数密友可倾诉,但他们并not能充分理解其认知扭曲;因对潜在灾难的担忧而经常临时取消与朋友的计划,友谊因此受损
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病;以往without类似心理问题的治疗或经历
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude,略感Anxiety;能清晰表达并愿意配合记录与Reflection

basic_info.main_problem: 我倾向于把事情灾难化,尤其在事情not按计划发展时.比如最近汽车抛锚,我立刻觉得它是一辆一文not值的车并且感到overwhelmed.这样的灾难化模式在几年前开始,并在压力情境下变得更频繁,导致我避免某些情境或采取极端措施来防止想象中的灾难,同时Increased anxiety,决策能力受影响.
basic_info.core_demands: 当我注意到这些思维模式影响我在Work中的决策并导致Increased anxiety时,我决定寻求咨询.
growth_experiences: 几年前开始出现Catastrophizing,在Work压力与经济Increased stress的情境下愈发频繁;在面对突发情况(如汽车爆胎)时迅速预设最坏结果,逐渐形成回避与Distraction的应对习惯.

core_beliefs: Once something goes wrong it will develop into the worst case
我without法有效应对突发状况

special_situations.event: Car breaks down from a flat tire on the way to work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现车辆故障,就意味着车一文not值,问题会难以解决且花费巨大,我会处理not好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 通过Distraction(购物)与回避(推迟处理,难以集中Work)来缓解Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这辆车一文not值,我修not好,会花很多钱

special_situations.event: Facing challenging or stressful tasks at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我在Work上处理not顺利,就等于彻底失败,后果会很糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids certain situations or takes extreme measures to prevent imagined disasters
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 事情会彻底失败,我应付not了

special_situations.event: Facing or worrying about financial pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果出现财务问题,生活会变得not可承受,事情会一团糟
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用临时的Distraction方式(购物)来降低Anxiety

special_situations.event: Upcoming social plans agreed with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦外出或事情not按计划发展,灾难就会发生,我将without法应对
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Temporarily cancels plans to avoid potential disaster
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I go out something might happen; I would break down

core_conflict.wish: Longs for controllability and safety, hopes to be understood and supported
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失控与最坏结果发生,担心without法承受后果
defense_goal: 通过回避与Distraction来降低Anxiety,维持表面上的可控感

object_relations.self_representation: A fragile individual who struggles to cope with emergencies
object_relations.object_representation: 世界/事件是not可控且充满风险的,他人并not真正理解我

manifestations: Temporarily cancels plans with friends out of worry about potential disaster; friendships are damaged
Feeling that others can hardly understand one's cognitive distortions

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Using shopping as a distraction when catastrophic thoughts appear
Tries to ignore negative automatic thoughts rather than face and process them directly

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: When facing social plans, cancels outings at the last minute, turning energy into self-exhaustion (worrying, distraction)
在压力情境中not去寻求外部支持,而是独自忍受并以Distraction方式自我处理

exception_events.target_problem: 在车辆出现故障等突发情境时,来访者通常会灾难化,感到overwhelmed,并在Work中难以集中且采取回避行为.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 那次只是轮胎漏气,来访者及时将轮胎修好,费用not高,最坏情况并not yet发生.
exception_events.reason: 线索:采取了及时处理的做法并获得事实证据(问题可被快速修复,成本not高),因此这次have not发展为灾难.

positive_force: Willing to record and examine automatic thoughts and evidence (reality testing)
能意识到'最坏情况通常have not发生'的实例
Willing to seek counseling support and cooperate with homework
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, and overgeneralization are prominent
回避行为与临时Distraction(购物)Habituation,导致问题not yet被加工
Work中的压力与Financial worriesReinforcement负性思维
Anxiety影响决策,注意与睡眠,进而损及人际

target_behavior.behavior: 在压力情境下出现Catastrophizing伴随Significant anxiety与回避
antecedent: Challenging and stressful tasks at work
Sudden incidents (e.g. a leaking car tire)
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic interpretation of potential negative outcomes and black-and-white thinking, over-focusing on negative cues while ignoring objective evidence
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪与感知风险,寻求短期缓解
target_behavior.consequence: 决策能力下降,注意力与Work表现受损,Sleep disturbance,Social avoidance加重

target_behavior.behavior: Temporarily cancels plans with friends to avoid imagined disasters
target_behavior.core_reason: 灾难化与过度概括导致对外出情境的最坏Anticipation
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在威胁,降低当下Anxiety

target_behavior.core_reason: Seeks external short-term stimulation to interrupt negative thoughts and emotions
target_behavior.function: Obtains short-term pleasure and relief, avoids directly processing the problem
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety短期降低但很快反弹,问题not yet得到解决
